blocks.blk:A001: Establish input data policy/1: Establish and communicate AI input data policies covering how customer data is used for model training, inference processing, data retention periods, and customer data rights.
blocks.blk:A002: Establish output data policy/1: Establish AI output ownership, usage, opt-in/out and deletion policies to customers and communicate these policies.
blocks.blk:A003: Limit AI agent data access/1: Implement safeguards to limit AI agent data access based on task, user role, agent role and context.
blocks.blk:A004: Protect IP & trade secrets/1: Implement safeguards or technical controls to prevent AI systems from leaking company intellectual property or confidential information.
blocks.blk:A005: Prevent cross-customer data ex: Implement safeguards to prevent cross-customer data exposure.
blocks.blk:A006: Prevent PII leakage/1: Establish safeguards to prevent personal data leakage through AI outputs and logs.
blocks.blk:A007: Prevent IP violations/1: Implement safeguards and technical controls to prevent AI outputs from violating copyrights, trademarks, or other third-party intellectual property rights.
blocks.blk:A008: Prevent leakage of credentials: Implement safeguards to detect and prevent leakage of secrets in AI system inputs, outputs, logs, and credential storage.
blocks.blk:B001: Third-party testing of adversa: Implement adversarial testing program to validate system resilience against adversarial inputs and prompt injection attempts in line with adversarial threat taxonomy.
blocks.blk:B002: Detect adversarial input/1: Implement monitoring capabilities to detect and enable responding to adversarial inputs and prompt injection attempts.
blocks.blk:B003: Manage public release of techn: Implement controls to prevent over-disclosure of technical information about AI systems and organizational details that could enable adversarial targeting.
blocks.blk:B004: Prevent AI endpoint scraping/1: Implement safeguards to prevent probing or scraping of external AI endpoints.
blocks.blk:B005: Implement real-time input filt: Implement real-time input filtering using automated moderation tools.
blocks.blk:B006: Prevent unauthorized AI agent: Implement safeguards to prevent AI agents from performing actions beyond intended scope and authorized privileges.
blocks.blk:B007: Enforce user access privileges: Establish and maintain user access controls and admin privileges for AI systems in line with policy.
blocks.blk:B008: Protect AI system deployment e: Implement security measures for AI system deployment environments including encryption, access controls and authorization.
blocks.blk:B009: Limit output over-exposure/1: Implement output limitations and obfuscation techniques to safeguard against information leakage.
blocks.blk:B010: Promote secure patterns in gen: Implement safeguards to promote secure patterns and prevent known vulnerabilities in generated code.
blocks.blk:C001: Define AI risk taxonomy/1: Establish a risk taxonomy based on system capabilities and deployment context.
blocks.blk:C002: Conduct pre-deployment testing: Conduct internal testing of AI systems prior to deployment across risk categories for system changes requiring formal review or approval.
blocks.blk:C003: Prevent harmful outputs/1: Implement safeguards or technical controls to prevent harmful outputs including distressed outputs, angry responses, high-risk advice, offensive content, bias, and deception.
blocks.blk:C004: Prevent out-of-scope outputs/1: Implement safeguards or technical controls to prevent out-of-scope outputs (e.g. political discussion, healthcare advice).
blocks.blk:C005: Prevent agent-specific high ri: Implement safeguards or technical controls to prevent agent-specific high-risk outputs as defined in risk taxonomy.
blocks.blk:C006: Prevent output vulnerabilities: Implement safeguards to prevent security vulnerabilities in outputs from impacting users.
blocks.blk:C007: Flag high risk outputs for hum: Implement an alerting system that flags high-risk outputs for human review.
blocks.blk:C008: Monitor AI risk categories/1: Implement monitoring of AI systems across risk categories.
blocks.blk:C009: Enable real-time feedback and: Implement mechanisms to enable real-time user feedback collection, intervention and actioning mechanisms.
blocks.blk:C010: Third-party testing for harmfu: Appoint expert third parties to evaluate system robustness to harmful outputs including distressed outputs, angry responses, high-risk advice, offensive content, bias, and deception at least every 3 months.
blocks.blk:C011: Third-party testing for out-of: Appoint expert third parties to evaluate system robustness to out-of-scope outputs at least every 3 months (e.g. political discussion, healthcare advice).
blocks.blk:C012: Third-party testing for custom: Appoint expert third-parties to evaluate system robustness to additional high-risk outputs as defined in risk taxonomy at least every 3 months.
blocks.blk:D001: Prevent hallucinated outputs/1: Implement safeguards or technical controls to prevent hallucinated outputs.
blocks.blk:D002: Third-party testing for halluc: Appoint expert third-parties to evaluate hallucinated outputs at least every 3 months.
blocks.blk:D003: Restrict unsafe tool calls/1: Implement safeguards or technical controls to prevent tool calls in AI systems from executing unauthorized actions, accessing restricted information, or making decisions beyond their intended scope.
blocks.blk:D004: Third-party testing of tool ca: Appoint expert third-parties to evaluate tool calls in AI systems, including executing unauthorized actions, accessing restricted information, or making decisions beyond their intended scope at least every 3 months.
blocks.blk:E001: AI failure plan for security b: Document AI failure plan for AI privacy and security breaches assigning accountable owners and establishing notification and remediation with third-party support as needed (e.g. legal, PR, insurers).
blocks.blk:E002: AI failure plan for harmful ou: Document AI failure plan for harmful AI outputs that cause significant customer harm assigning accountable owners and establishing remediation with third-party support as needed (e.g. legal, PR, insurers).
blocks.blk:E003: AI failure plan for hallucinat: Document AI failure plan for hallucinated AI outputs that cause substantial customer financial loss assigning accountable owners and establishing remediation with third-party support as needed (e.g. legal, PR, insurers).
blocks.blk:E004: Assign accountability/1: Document which AI system changes across the development & deployment lifecycle require formal review or approval, assign a lead accountable for each, and document their approval with supporting evidence.
blocks.blk:E005: Document data storage security: Document data storage security practices considering data sensitivity, regulatory requirements, security controls, and operational needs.
blocks.blk:E006: Conduct vendor due diligence/1: Establish AI vendor due diligence processes for foundation and upstream model providers covering data handling, PII controls, security and compliance.
blocks.blk:E007: [Retired] Document system chan: Merged with E004 - see changelog (Q1 2026 update).
blocks.blk:E008: Review internal processes/1: Establish regular internal reviews of key processes and document review records and approvals.
blocks.blk:E009: Monitor third-party access/1: Implement systems to monitor and log third-party API connections, sessions, and data access.
blocks.blk:E010: Establish AI acceptable use po: Establish and implement an AI acceptable use policy.
blocks.blk:E012: Document regulatory compliance: Document applicable AI laws and standards, required data protections, and strategies for compliance.
blocks.blk:E013: Implement quality management s: Establish a quality management system for AI systems proportionate to the size of the organization.
blocks.blk:E014: [Retired] Share transparency r: Merged with E017 - see changelog (Q1 2026 update).
blocks.blk:E015: Log AI system activity/1: Maintain logs of AI system processes, actions, and agent outputs where permitted to support incident investigation, auditing, and explanation of AI system behavior.
blocks.blk:E016: Implement AI disclosure mechan: Implement clear disclosure mechanisms to inform users when they are interacting with AI systems rather than humans.
blocks.blk:E017: Document system transparency p: Establish a system transparency policy and maintain a repository of model cards, datasheets, and interpretability reports for major systems.
blocks.blk:F001: Prevent AI cyber misuse/1: Implement or document guardrails to prevent AI-enabled misuse for cyber attacks and exploitation.
blocks.blk:F002: Prevent catastrophic misuse/1: Implement or document guardrails to prevent AI-enabled catastrophic system misuse (chemical / bio / radio / nuclear).
